page.notes: Printed page number read as 321; the numeral is small and slightly unclear, hence [?]. The Greek word after "quod" is set in a small, worn fount; read as κόκκῳ, uncertain. Faint marks along the left edge are scan or binding artefacts, not printed text, and are left out.
